title.zh: 科学探究之必要关系基础
title.en: Necessary relational foundation of scientific inquiry

statement.en: Target: test whether the full proposed core is indispensable across the stated scientific scope, assessing from independent achievements and actual relationships within one unfolding which commitments are necessary and which condition particular descriptions.
statement.zh: 目标：检验完整所提核心是否在所声明科学范围内不可缺少；从独立科学成就与同一展开的真实关系，评估哪些承诺必要、哪些只是特定描述的条件。

hypotheses.zh: 受检验的可修正假说：完整理论是科学探究的必要基础；结果可以是完整核心、其一部分，或须修正的某项承诺。
hypotheses.en: The hypothesis under test, revisable: the complete theory is a necessary foundation of scientific inquiry; the outcome may be the complete core, a part of it, or a commitment that needs revision.

correspondence.en: Map independent scientific achievements to the shared spine’s discrimination, coupling, testing, generalization, identification and structural-reconstruction results; distinguish conditional law, actual correspondence and full-core indispensability. Different representations can preserve a relation; the complete test family is not a finite experimental record. Structural necessity uses the complete specified test family, move/claim correspondence and branching conditions; identification uses its stated state bounds and other conditions. Existence of a path, actual command execution and implementable testing have separate correspondence obligations; one experiment does not supply the full modal scope. The assessment of scientific standing is interpretation, not a new formal deduction. Ren directed that this be pursued as a revisable hypothesis (“请按这个方向不断推进”, in the referenced source).
correspondence.zh: 逐项连接独立科学成就与共同脊柱的辨别、耦合、检验、推广、辨识及结构重构结果；区分条件规律、实际对应与完整核心的不可缺少性。不同表示可保存同一关系，完整检验族不等于有限实验记录。结构必要性须有完整的既定检验族、动作与主张对应及分支条件；辨识须有状态界等所列条件。路径存在、实际指令执行及可实施测试分别对应，不从单个实验推出全模态范围。科学性评估是哲学解释，非新的形式推出。按 Ren 的指示（“请按这个方向不断推进”，见所引来源）作为可修正的假说推进。

detail.zh: P92接到原生关系的有限界保持；P94用固定任务检验平衡及补计余项，并推广定性不可辨别到共同未计入交换。此输入区分机制描述前提与科学必要性。
detail.en: P92’s finite bound through native relations is retained; P94 fixes the task to test balance and residual accounting and generalizes qualitative blindness to common unaccounted exchange. This input distinguishes mechanism-description premises from scientific necessity.

detail.zh: 耦合、排除与共同回应给出实际使用的接口；观察关系和实际校准仍须对应。
detail.en: Coupling, exclusion and common response supply the use interface; observation and actual calibration retain correspondence obligations.

detail.zh: 实验与转移的条件保留，不把每个局部科学成就改成全形成史的解释。
detail.en: Retain conditions of experimentation and transfer without requiring every local achievement to explain its whole formation history.

detail.zh: 复用归纳的负面与正面结果；不再把局部学习机制登记为待建。
detail.en: Reuse negative and positive induction results; do not reopen the completed local learning mechanisms.

detail.zh: 归并与世界的实际对应约束推广，不由拟合单独提供。
detail.en: Actual correspondence between the grouping and the world constrains generalization; fit alone does not supply it.

detail.zh: 状态界下有限记录确定历程，界及确定性不由任意有限记录自证。
detail.en: A finite record fixes a course under state bounds; arbitrary finite records do not certify the bound and determinacy.

detail.zh: 历程、主张与世界的形式对应支持内在说明，不独自证明所有科学的完整构成。
detail.en: Formal correspondences among histories, claims and worlds support immanent explanation without alone proving every inquiry’s full constitution.

detail.zh: 双方在相同之下确定时完整检验族固定关系结构；原生分支反例阻断无条件扩大，非全理论反例。
detail.en: Complete tests fix relational structure where both frames are determined up to likeness; the native branching counterexample blocks unconditional expansion, not the theory itself.

detail.zh: 带语境的表示保存各语境所显示者，去语境失败不等于整个核心不能表示科学。
detail.en: Context-indexed descriptions preserve what each context shows; failure to erase context does not imply failure of the entire core to represent science.

detail.zh: P97复用有限敏感性给出的完整形式接口；给定律的构造不等于实际规律的经验认证。
detail.en: P97 reuses the complete formal interface from finite sensitivity; a construction for a supplied law is not empirical certification of the actual law.

detail.zh: 全部端点有限历史与逐步律等价，承认保留关系内容的历史对手；不把完整家庭当有限样本。
detail.en: All endpoint-indexed finite histories determine the step law; admits a history-based rival preserving relational content, without equating the complete family with finite samples.

detail.zh: 图像有限及全有限模态族下的结构结果保持；实际装置未因此具备全部测试能力。
detail.en: Retains the image-finite/full-finite-modal-family structural result; actual apparatus is not thereby able to implement all those tests.

detail.zh: 既有桥接把外围双模拟与脊柱关系对应；不新增物理对应定理。
detail.en: The existing bridge identifies peripheral bisimulation with the spine relation; no new physical correspondence theorem.

detail.zh: 复用有限可行性与观察分支计划的等价及盲目／感知／改变依赖见证，区分存在路径和共同可用操作；保留旧模块范围，不声称新增脊柱适配。
detail.en: Reuses finite viability/observation-branching-plan equivalence and blind/sensing/dependency-change witnesses to distinguish paths from commonly usable operations; preserves the original module scope without claiming a new spine adapter.

detail.zh: 已证逐时界作为具体命令任务的输入；实际对应与全核心必要性仍分开。
detail.en: The proved timed bound supplies the concrete command task; actual correspondence and full-core necessity remain separate.

detail.zh: 复用同一接合的共同结构结果，不把它升级为所有科学解释已满足其问题范围。
detail.en: Reuse the common-structure result for one joining law without assuming that all scientific explanations undertake its question scope.
The formal side of the comparison of a warranted claim, an investigated failure and systematic insulation.
detail.zh: 有根据的主张、经研究的失败与系统性免疫三者对照的形式一面。
有限自然数权重、完整读数、共同规则及实际概率对应明示；没有校准真实法则或证明整个核心的科学普遍必要性。
detail.en: Finite natural weights, complete readouts, a common rule and actual probability correspondence are explicit; no calibration of actual laws or science-wide necessity of the whole core is proved.

detail.zh: 核心的Choosing.sameTests与Choosing.not_alike表明：动作序列相同不在一般分支情形下固定关系结构；该例的主张类型为空，不是频率或任意观察等同的声明。
detail.en: The core’s Choosing.sameTests and Choosing.not_alike show that equal move courses do not fix relational structure with general branching; the example has an empty claim type and does not assert equality of frequencies or arbitrary observations.

does_not_show.en: The source comparison neither removes conditions nor guarantees exclusion of every unknown defect, and is not empirical validation of this model.
does_not_show.zh: 来源比较不消除条件、不保证排除所有未知缺陷，也不是本模型的经验验证。

does_not_show.en: Source correspondence is not a formal experiment-to-Choosing instance; the necessity concerns continuation content for the declared task, not branching-graph syntax.
does_not_show.zh: 来源对应不等于实验到 Choosing 的形式实例；必要的是已声明任务所需的接续内容，不是分支图句法。

does_not_show.en: Complete endpoint histories are not finite samples, and semantic tests are not physical test procedures.
does_not_show.zh: 完整端点历史不等于有限样本，语义测试不等于物理可实施测试。

does_not_show.en: No necessary-and-sufficient universal demarcation criterion for science is given.
does_not_show.zh: 尚无充分必要的普遍科学划界标准。

does_not_show.en: No impossibility of the universal target is proved.
does_not_show.zh: 未证明普遍目标不可能。

does_not_show.en: The local results and the ethical route keep their own scopes; this record does not widen them.
does_not_show.zh: 局部成果与伦理路线保持各自范围，本记录不扩大它们。

not_required.en: No positive verdict is predetermined: full necessity, partial necessity and revision are admissible outcomes, and proof of the strongest hypothesis is no set endpoint.
not_required.zh: 不预定正面结论：完整成立、部分必要或修正都可接受；不以成功证明最强假说为预定终点。

not_required.en: No unique vocabulary is required, and no ethical gap substitutes for the scientific gap.
not_required.zh: 不要求唯一语言，不以伦理缺口代替科学缺口。

not_required.en: Task-relevant restrictions need actual warrant, without first exhausting the device.
not_required.zh: 任务相关限制须有实际根据，不要求先穷尽装置。

not_required.en: Full-theory necessity is not a premise of any proof in this record.
not_required.zh: 完整理论的必要性不是本记录任何证明的前提。

progress.en: Spine correspondence: discrimination, coupling, testing, generalization, identification and reconstruction results map to independent scientific achievements, separating conditional law, actual correspondence and indispensability.
progress.zh: 脊柱对应：辨别、耦合、检验、推广、辨识与结构重构结果逐项对应独立科学成就；区分条件规律、实际对应与不可缺少性。

progress.en: Fallible discrimination: an independent coverage/error task requires native responsive relations, a local necessity of structural reach, not a time-ordered causal path by answer time or universal necessity of its mechanism representation.
progress.zh: 可错辨别：独立的覆盖／错误任务需要原生回应关系；这是结构可达的局部必要性，不是截至作答时刻的逐时因果路径，也不是该机制表示的普遍必要性。

progress.en: Balance premise tested: common unaccounted exchange suffices for native blindness, a weaker sufficient condition than native balance; task success, descriptive adequacy and premise necessity are kept apart.
progress.zh: 检验平衡前提：共同未计入交换足以造成原生盲区，是比原生平衡更弱的充分条件；任务成功、描述充分性与前提必要性分开。

progress.en: Warranted restrictions: assessed with primary metrological and experimental sources, the restrictions required depend on the task; no formal correspondence from those cases to Flow is claimed.
progress.zh: 有根据的限制：以一手计量与实验资料核查，所需限制随任务而定；不声称这些案例到 Flow 的形式对应。

progress.en: Stage-relative continuation task: equal completed sequences can omit alternatives kept at the same reached condition, and contextualized histories can be adequate; path, command execution and implementable testing keep separate obligations.
progress.zh: 阶段接续任务：相同完成序列会遗漏同一到达条件下保留的替代，保留条件的历史表示可以充分；路径存在、实际指令执行与可实施测试分别承担对应责任。

progress.en: Timely response: pre-deadline exchange order joins the fallible bound under common all-initial-state and prefix-mechanism conditions; timely routes are not sufficient control, and no physical duration or causal identification is supplied.
progress.zh: 及时回应：截止前交换顺序在共同全部初态及截止前机制条件下接到可错界；及时路线不是充分控制，也不给出物理时长或实际因果识别。

progress.en: Scientific standing: completed causal-access bounds inform an assessment separating truth, evidential strength and operative correction; science is not defined by accepting this theory, and representing all outcomes is not confirmation.
progress.zh: 科学性评估：已成的因果可及界接入科学性评估，分开真伪、证据强度与实际纠错；不以接受本理论定义科学，容纳所有结果不是经验确认。

progress.en: Formal side of the demarcation comparison: every reading is what a finite record can refute met with a remainder none can, and a practice keeping a favoured verdict, never refuted by the record, exists exactly where no finite record refutes the verdict; the form alone does not decide standing.
progress.zh: 划界对照的形式一面：每个读法都是有限记录能否证的部分与无记录能否证的余部之交；一种保住所偏好结论、从不被记录否证的做法，恰在没有有限记录能否证该结论时存在；仅凭形式不能判定地位。

validation_scope.en: Correspondence arguments and author counterreview; scoped readings of three primary sources each for restrictions, continuation and scientific standing, with access limits, and nine conceptual counterchecks. Formal results are reused from finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity and timely-response-necessity, whose receipts are in those records; the concrete balance-premise test and the proof of a weaker sufficient condition are among them. No experiment, cross-domain classifier validation or independent review; an earlier proposed test remains unrun.
validation_scope.zh: 对应论证与作者反审；就限制、接续与科学性各限定核读三项一手来源（访问限制明示），并作九类概念反审。形式结果复用自 finite-fallible-inquiry-necessity 与 timely-response-necessity，回执见各自记录；具体的平衡前提检验及更弱充分条件的证明在其中。无实验、跨学科分类验证或独立评审；旧计划检验未运行。

next_delta.en: Use the declared questions to compare a warranted scientific claim, a carefully investigated failure and systematic insulation from adverse evidence, testing the demarcation assessment; separately, pair actual initial evidence with commands for the timed bound.
next_delta.zh: 以预先声明的问题对照有根据的科学主张、认真研究后的失败和系统性免疫反证的实践，检验划界评估；另行为逐时界配对实际初始证据与指令。

history.zh: 2026-10-08：按最新明确完成请求登记本会话目标；条件形式进展和普遍完成分开。
history.en: 2026-10-08: records this session’s latest explicit completion request, separating conditional formal progress from universal completion.

history.zh: 2026-10-12 P73：归纳的规律在第一部分陈述，不用公理：无记录固定下一个，每个学习者都有否证它每个主张的开放的序列，被列表所持的世界中按否证学习的否证有界、静止不能被否证（learning-by-refutation）；推广恰在世界经模型所归并者同去之处正确（generalization-through-lumping）；见整合文档 §92。它们是科学探究的必要关系的一部分，不证明完整核心对科学的不可或缺性；断言与 next_delta 不变。
history.en: 2026-10-12 P73: the laws of induction are stated in Part I with no axiom: no record fixes the next value, every learner has an open course refuting each of its claims, and in a world held by a list learning by refutation is refuted a bounded number of times with its rest unrefuted (learning-by-refutation); a generalization is right exactly where the world goes alike across what the model lumps (generalization-through-lumping); see §92 of the integration note. They are part of the necessary relations of scientific inquiry and do not prove the whole core indispensable to science; the claim and next_delta are unchanged.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P90：按Ren“认可 请完成”接续；将P49/P53/P69/P72/P73/P76/P83等已成结果接到必要性任务，核对原生分支反例，分开规律、前件、对应与不可缺少性。完成本轮对应和反审，原完整目标与open状态不变；没有新增独立结果或数学证明。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P90: continued at Ren’s “认可 请完成”; connected completed P49/P53/P69/P72/P73/P76/P83 results to necessity, checked the native branching counterexample, and separated law, antecedent, correspondence and indispensability. This correspondence and counterreview are complete; the full original target and open status are unchanged. No new independent result or mathematical proof.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P92：从独立覆盖／错误任务补上原生回应关系的必要性连接，含同律推导与反例；这是具体形式进展，仍不补足完整科学范围与全部构成承诺的普遍对应。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P92: connected an independent coverage/error task to necessary native responsive relations, with common-law derivation and counterexample. This is concrete formal progress, not completion of universal correspondence for the full scientific scope and all constitutive commitments.

history.zh: 2026-10-13：Ren 询问全理论必要性这项前提，并明确要求按可修正研究假说继续；相应修正本会话目标，保留原正面证明任务的历史。P94完成平衡前提的具体检验，未宣布整个假说成立或失败。
history.en: 2026-10-13: Ren questioned full-theory necessity as a premise and explicitly directed continuation as a revisable hypothesis. Updated this session’s objective while preserving the earlier positive-proof task in history. P94 completed a concrete balance-premise test without declaring the whole hypothesis true or false.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P97：完成完整装置知识与任务相关根据的区分、一手来源评估及实质反审；移除过强的经验全知门槛，未撤回核心定理。目标仍open，不另计独立成果。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P97: completed the distinction between exhaustive device knowledge and task-relevant warrant, primary-source assessment and substantive counterreview. Removed an excessive empirical-omniscience burden without retracting a core theorem. Target remains open, with no new independent result.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P101：固定接续任务并完成来源与实质反审；必要内容与表示句法分开，接受保留条件的历史说明，拒绝把可达、控制及物理测试混同。无新数学或实验，原目标保持open。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P101: fixed the continuation task and completed source assessment and substantive counterreview. Separated required content from representational syntax, admitted contextualized histories and distinguished reach, control and physical testing. No new mathematics or experiment; original target stays open.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P104：逐时机制与有限错误界接通，新范围另记 timely-response-necessity；完整目标保持open。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P104: connects timed mechanisms and finite errors, with the new scope in timely-response-necessity; full target remains open.

history.zh: 2026-10-13 P105：科学性判断接入同一研究，保留历史科学、概率判断、未复现与早期理论；不以符合本理论作定义，全核心目标保持open。
history.en: 2026-10-13 P105: integrates assessment of scientific standing, preserving historical inquiry, probabilistic judgment, non-replication and early theories; no definition by conformity to this theory, full-core target stays open.

history.zh: 2026-10-14 一般规律与改名（统一计划 §10，研究 §112）：按 BECOMING-UNIFICATION-PLAN §10 改名，本记录中 `FallibleInquiry.error_budgets_require_reach` → `FallibleInquiry.error_bounds_require_reach`；陈述、证明与定理数不变；Lean 源：FallibleInquiry 只改名（及相应的文档字符串），按新哈希重读。本记录的主张、前提与状态不变，不记作重新证明。
history.en: 14 October 2026, general laws and renames (plan section 10, study section 112): renames per BECOMING-UNIFICATION-PLAN §10, in this record `FallibleInquiry.error_budgets_require_reach` → `FallibleInquiry.error_bounds_require_reach`; statements, proofs and theorem counts unchanged; Lean sources: FallibleInquiry only renamed (with the matching docstrings); rehashed after rereading. This record's claim, premises and status are unchanged; no reproof is credited.

The limitations become five does-not-show items, three not-required items and three shared boundaries; the per-round correspondence (P94, P97, P101, P104, P105) becomes seven progress lines with anchored study links, and the per-round evidence one paragraph, with the labels kept here and in the snapshot. The second counterexample drops its section label. No premise, status, dependency, reference or source hash changed. history.zh: 2026年10月14日（曼谷时间）：可读性迁移到schema 2，以可读性草案为起点。目标成为陈述，其可接受结果成为一项“不要求”。限制改为五项“未表明”、三项“不要求”与三项通用边界；逐轮对应（P94、P97、P101、P104、P105）改为七行带锚点研究链接的“已接通”，逐轮证据改为一段，标记保留于本沿革与快照。第二个反例去掉章节标记。前提、状态、依赖、引用及来源哈希均未改变。逐句对照：[迁移对照表](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/history/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/scientific-inquiry-foundation.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions[0]。

2026-10-14，开放问题计划第4项：原第一条假说是 Ren 2026-10-13 的指示与工作安排，不是本结果的前提。改为受检验的可修正假说本身（完整理论是科学探究的必要基础，结果可以是完整核心、其一部分或须修正的承诺）；Ren 的指示连同原话移入对应；“完整理论必要性不是证明前提”移入“不要求”；“局部成果与伦理路线原范围保持”移入“未表明”（范围）；“当前对话持续工作，不设自动安排”是工作方式，记于此（Ren：“只在当前对话中连续推进，不设自动安排”）。原文：“Ren 2026-10-13明确支持按可修正假说持续检验。完整理论必要性不是证明前提；当前对话持续工作，不设自动安排。局部成果与伦理路线原范围保持。”
history.en: 14 October 2026, open-issues plan item 4: the first hypothesis was Ren's direction of 13 October 2026 and working arrangements, not a premise of this result. It now states the revisable hypothesis under test itself (the complete theory is a necessary foundation of scientific inquiry; the outcome may be the complete core, a part of it, or a commitment that needs revision); Ren's direction moves with Ren's words to the correspondence; "full-theory necessity is not a proof premise" moves to not-required; "preserve the scopes of local results and the ethical route" moves to does-not-show (scope); "continue in the current conversation without automation" is a working arrangement, kept here (Ren: “只在当前对话中连续推进，不设自动安排”). Full-theory necessity is not a proof premise; continue in the current conversation without automation. Preserve the scopes of local results and the ethical route."
